verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms only glTF import via the built-in GLTFLoader; there is no mention of FBX or USD loader support in the pack. Community sentiment further notes that loading even a simple model format was not straightforward, undercutting a 'clean import' claim. Missing for 10: FBX loader/exporter evidence, USD loader evidence, and confirmation of clean cross-format fidelity (materials, animations, textures) beyond glTF.
